name: Université PSL
summary: Collegiate Paris university (ENS, Dauphine, Mines Paris and more); two English bachelor's: AI in Paris, and engineering in Sophia Antipolis.

ib.text: No set IB points. The AI bachelor's wants advanced maths and C1 English and runs through Parcoursup; the engineering bachelor's has its own portal.

programmes.name: International Bachelor of Science in AI
programmes.about: Mathematics, algorithms and programming, then machine learning, vision, language processing and robotics, with research internships in PSL labs; all classes in English, in central Paris.
programmes.ib: Advanced maths (analysis, calculus, complex numbers, probability) and C1 English expected (as asked for 2026 entry).
programmes.selectionNote: Selection on the Parcoursup file: academic record, language skills and motivation.

programmes.name: International Bachelor of Environmentally Engaged Engineering
programmes.about: New in 2026 from Mines Paris-PSL and Chimie Paris-PSL: project-based general engineering for energy, water, health, climate and cities, with data science throughout; taught in English.
programmes.ib: B2 English and A2 French (non-French speakers). International applicants apply on Mines Paris's own portal; remote interview in English.
programmes.selectionNote: File (transcripts, CV, two references, motivation letter), then a video interview in English for those shortlisted.
programmes.tuitionEuEea: Up to €15,000 a year, lower by income

notes: Sustainability Sciences is bilingual, moving into English over three years (B2 English and C1 French recommended), so it is not listed as English-taught.
The 2027 Parcoursup calendar is not out; in 2026 wishes closed on 12 March and files were confirmed by 1 April.
